name: Sustainable Communities Challenge Fund
summary: Provincial climate-action grants for Nova Scotia community organizations; the adaptation stream funds ecosystem and nature-based projects such as coastal restoration, alongside mitigation work like buildings and energy.
reporting: Brief quarterly progress reports; after completion a final impact report with a financial report.

applicant_types.quote: The following groups are eligible lead applicants: Nova Scotia municipalities First Nations bands and tribal councils Post-secondary institutions Non-profit organizations operating in Nova Scotia

geography.quote: The Sustainable Communities Challenge Fund is a provincial grant program for local action on climate change in Nova Scotia.

access.quote: Create an account and log into the Submittable portal to complete the pre-screening form.

amount.quote: The Fund will provide non-repayable grants between $75,000 and $1,000,000 per project that range from 60 - 80% of eligible project costs.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of 20% of eligible project costs must be contributed by the applicant.

reporting.quote: Recipients are required to provide brief quarterly progress reports on whether their project is on track and any challenges they are experiencing. Upon project completion recipients submit a Final Impact Report, including a financial report on how the Fund was spent,
